about: Which keys turn the page. Input: the key, whether Shift is held, what it was pressed on (page, button, or field: a text box, dropdown or slider, which use keys themselves), and whether a panel is open over the book. Output: left, right, next, prev, or null for not turning the page.

cases.name: space on the page goes on
shift-space on the page goes back
space on a focused button presses it
an arrow still turns the page after clicking a button
arrows on a dropdown change it
typing j in a box is typing
the book stays put behind an open panel: arrow
the book stays put behind an open panel: space
